record_attributes.thread.id: worker.thread_id; execution-thread fact, not worker resource identity
record_attributes.rustvello.worker.role: submitter for Submitted; executor for Started/Succeeded/Failed/RetryScheduled

Failed.span: end attempt, ERROR; sanitized error category only

event_fields.context_version: must equal native_lifecycle_version; unknown versions fail adapter validation
event_fields.event_time: original UTC event time in nanoseconds; observed timestamp is receipt/export time, never a substitute when event time exists
event_fields.duration: monotonic execution duration converted to seconds; record rustvello.duration.s on terminal logs/spans; do not derive start from duration if Started was lost
event_fields.next_attempt: rustvello.next_attempt on RetryScheduled; integer greater than current attempt
event_fields.error: redacted; export an allowlisted rustvello.error.type category, never the original error string
event_fields.worker_events: resource context plus mapping revision and event name only; no fabricated task/attempt context
event_fields.unknown_events: reject adapter mapping visibly rather than reinterpret as success

relationships.retry: new span ID; same invocation and inherited trace parent; link previous attempt when known; never reparent to the failed attempt
relationships.child: active parent execution span overrides persisted ancestor; retain parent invocation and workflow independently of sampling
relationships.missing_start: emit terminal log; do not invent execution start or span duration
relationships.missing_process_start: preserve hostname/PID but leave process join unresolved
relationships.kubernetes: preserve verified k8s.cluster.uid, k8s.namespace.name, k8s.pod.uid, container.id; never infer pod or process from worker name

sampling: honor W3C sampled flag for spans; lifecycle logs are independent and may retain unsampled trace/span correlation; absent span is not absent task
redaction: never export arguments, return values, raw exception messages, environment, credentials or baggage; allowlist attributes above and verified identity enrichment

metrics.missing: NoRecordedValue flag means missing even with numeric placeholder; measured zero remains a value

receiver_profile.ack: SQLite durable journal plus decoded projection committed atomically
receiver_profile.dedup: metrics by stream/interval and spans by trace/span; conflicts rejected; logs at-least-once
receiver_profile.query: /api/v1/telemetry/records, version 1; bounded by bytes, count and time
